name: sessionlog_normalize_path
description: Normalize a transcript file or folder to canonical Session Log YAML and a selected Claude, Codex, or Grok compatibility profile.

path.description: Transcript file or folder path, workspace-relative or allowed absolute path.

targetProfile.description: Required target profile: Claude, Codex, or Grok.

source.description: Optional transcript source: Auto, Claude, Codex, Grok, Cline, Copilot, or OpenCode.

strict.description: Whether malformed records fail the bundle.

persist.description: Whether to persist through the ingestion persistence path. Defaults false for manual normalization.
